records.name: Sokrates Rückfrage
records.biography_en: Rückfrage waits in the HyperNorm corridor with a cup held below the next objection. A card suggesting that uncertainty can be useful earns his enormous questioning eyebrow: an answer is either examined or suspiciously convenient. Men in Black request a clear conclusion. He touches his chin, considering whether their request is an instruction or another promising subject for discussion.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Antwort liegt vor. Ihre Bedeutung wurde zur weiteren Befragung vorgeladen.

variant_notes.note_en: He is willing to accept an answer once somebody can explain what accepting it would mean.

records.name: Platon Überbau
records.biography_en: Überbau presents the HyperNorm residents with a scroll and a finger directed toward a better arrangement. A card allowing an imperfect example to remain worthwhile draws his hopeful unequal gaze: a thing is either proper or merely present. Hunky & Dory admire the vision. He looks upward, briefly leaving the actual doorway to negotiate its own inadequate dimensions.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der Entwurf ist vollkommen. Das Gebäude hat sich bislang nur näherungsweise angeschlossen.

variant_notes.note_en: He suspects the official plan would work perfectly if the building stopped insisting on being material.

records.name: Aristoteles Einsort
records.biography_en: Einsort studies a leaf against the HyperNorm record tablet with a fingertip holding the evidence steady. A card suggesting that a useful category can retain exceptions tightens his lip: a specimen is either classified or awaiting attention. Men in Black request a definite place for everything. He examines the edge again, hoping that the leaf will disclose where the boundary ought to go.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Das Merkmal ist festgestellt. Seine Zugehörigkeit wurde dem Blatt noch nicht überzeugend vermittelt.

variant_notes.note_en: He has found the right category and is investigating the specimen's reasons for resisting it.

records.name: Diogenes Unzuständig
records.biography_en: Unzuständig carries a lamp and a very small jar through the HyperNorm reception area as an unsolicited demonstration of sufficiency. A card allowing independence to include accepting help earns his crooked laugh: a requirement is either necessary or somebody else's furniture. Hunky & Dory request a respectable arrangement. He raises the lamp, wondering whether respectability has been hiding in the unused space.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der Bedarf wurde reduziert. Die Umgebung meldet weiterhin erhebliche Ansprüche an.

variant_notes.note_en: He has reduced his requirements until the remaining inconvenience belongs mostly to everyone else.

records.name: Hypatia Umlauf
records.biography_en: Umlauf turns a brass ring model in the HyperNorm study corner while keeping the stylus near the troublesome part. A card allowing explanation to remain revisable brightens her unequal eyes: an account is either coherent or not yet carefully enough considered. Men in Black request a settled picture. She tilts the rings, delighted that another angle has produced another worthwhile question.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Das Modell ist geschlossen. Die Untersuchung hat einen weiteren Umlauf beantragt.

variant_notes.note_en: She enjoys a coherent model most at the instant something small refuses to fit it.

records.name: Epikura Genug
records.biography_en: Genug occupies the HyperNorm courtyard with a bread roll and a cup that has no ceremonial ambitions. A card suggesting that contentment can coexist with an unfinished world draws her smallest satisfied smile: a desire is either necessary or an avoidable appointment. Hunky & Dory propose another upgrade. She holds the bread a moment longer, leaving the proposal pleasantly unnecessary.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Zufriedenheit ist eingetreten. Eine Erweiterung des Bedarfs wurde nicht veranlasst.

variant_notes.note_en: She has enough and finds the repeated request for improvement mildly exhausting.
